STATE OF VERMONT 
PUBLIC UTILITY COMMISSION 
 
Case No. 26-0096-TF 
 
Tariff filing of Green Mountain Power 
Corporation for a 7.5% rate increase effective 
with bills rendered on or after October 1, 
2026 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Order entered:  
 
ORDER APPROVING COMPLIANCE TARIFFS  
On August 28, 2026, the Vermont Public Utility Commission (“Commission”) issued an 
order partially approving a proposed rate increase for Green Mountain Power Corporation 
(“GMP”).1  The Commission directed GMP to file a revised cost of service, calculating the 
precise increase authorized by the Commission’s decision.  The Commission also directed GMP 
to file revised tariffs consistent with the order.   
On September 4, 2026, GMP filed a revised cost of service for Fiscal Year 2027 
(“FY27”) resulting in a final rate increase of 5.51% after implementing the Commission’s 
authorized return on equity of 9.05% and adjusting the resilience spending for FY27.  GMP also 
filed revised tariffs to reflect the 5.51% rate increase to be effective with bills rendered October 
1, 2026. 
On September 17, 2026, the Vermont Department of Public Service (“Department”) filed 
comments stating that it “has reviewed and does not oppose GMP’s compliance tariffs.” 
The Commission has reviewed GMP’s compliance tariffs and revised cost of service, as 
well as the recommendation of the Department.  We conclude that the compliance tariffs comply 
with the August 28 order.  Therefore, we approve GMP’s revised tariffs reflecting a 5.51% rate 
increase effective with bills rendered October 1, 2026, and this case is closed. 
 
SO ORDERED. 
 
 
1 .  Petition of Green Mountain Power Corporation for approval of its new Multi-Year Regulation Plan pursuant 
to 30 V.S.A. Sections 108, 209, 218, and 218d, and Tariff filing of Green Mountain Power Corporation for a 7.5% 
rate increase effective with bills rendered on or after October 1, 2026, Case Nos. 25-1955-PET and 26-0096-TF, 
Order of 8/28/26.
